children.definition: This group comprises conventional crude oil, crude and diluted bitumen, and synthetic crude oil.

children.label: Conventional crude oil
children.definition: This class comprises crude oil (a mixture of hydrocarbons in liquid phase) extracted by conventional methods from underground reservoirs.

children.label: Conventional crude oil
children.definition: This subclass comprises crude oil (a mixture of hydrocarbons in liquid phase) extracted by conventional methods from underground reservoirs.

children.label: Light and medium crude oil
children.definition: Light and medium crude oil with a density equal to or less than 875.7 kg/m³ (30.1°API).

children.label: Heavy crude oil
children.definition: Heavy crude oil with a density greater than 875.7 kg/m³ (30.1°API).

children.label: Crude and diluted bitumen
children.definition: This class comprises crude bitumen and bitumen mixed with diluents.

children.label: Crude and diluted bitumen
children.definition: This subclass comprises crude bitumen and bitumen mixed with diluents.

children.label: Crude bitumen
children.definition: Semi solid form of crude oil that does not flow unless it is heated or diluted with lighter hydrocarbons.

children.label: Diluted bitumen
children.definition: Crude bitumen that has been diluted so that it can be transported by pipeline.

children.label: Synthetic crude oil
children.definition: This class comprises synthetic crude oil, which refers to an intermediate product that is a mixture of hydrocarbons derived from the upgrading of crude bitumen into a transportable liquid form. Synthetic crude oil contains very little sulfur (less than 0.2% by weight) compared to other light crude oils due to its processing, and has a density between 834.8 and 870.8 kg/m³ (31.0°API to 38.0°API).

children.label: Synthetic crude oil

children.label: Natural gas liquids (including condensate) and related products
children.definition: This group comprises natural gas liquids (NGLs) and related products. NGLs are found in natural gas and include liquefied petroleum gases or LPGs (propane, butane), ethane, lease condensate, pentanes plus, among others.

children.label: Natural gas liquids (including condensate) and related products
children.definition: This class comprises natural gas liquids (NGLs) and related products. NGLs are found in natural gas and include liquefied petroleum gases or LPGs (propane, butane), ethane, lease condensate, pentanes plus, among others.

children.label: Liquefied petroleum gases (LPGs)
children.definition: This subclass comprises liquefied petroleum gases (LPGs) consisting primarily of propane and butane.

children.label: Propane and propane mixes
children.definition: Normally straight-chain gaseous paraffinic (saturated) hydrocarbon or compound (C3H8) extracted from natural gas or refinery gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -42° Celsius. Cover propane mixes.

children.label: Butane and butane mixes
children.definition: Normally straight-chain or branch-chain gaseous paraffinic hydrocarbon (C4H10) extracted from natural gas or refinery gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -1° Celsius. Covers butane mixes.

children.label: Natural gas liquids (except LPGs)
children.definition: This subclass comprises natural gas liquids, except liquefied petroleum gases (LPGs), and covers lease condensate and pentanes plus.

children.label: Ethane
children.definition: Straight-chain gaseous paraffinic (saturated) hydrocarbon (C2H6) extracted predominantly from natural gas streams. It is a colourless gas that boils at a temperature of -88° Celsius.

children.label: Lease condensate
children.definition: Light liquid hydrocarbons recovered from lease separators or field facilities at associated and non-associated natural gas wells, mostly pentanes and heavier hydrocarbons. Normally enter the crude oil stream after production.

children.label: Pentanes plus (including plant condensate)
children.definition: Mixture of mainly pentanes and heavier hydrocarbons that ordinarily contains butanes. Pentanes plus (also known as natural gasoline) is obtained from the processing of raw gas, condensate or crude oil.

children.label: Other natural gas liquids (NGLs) and related products, n.e.c.
children.definition: Natural gas liquids other than ethane, propane and butane, and similar products.

children.label: Coal
children.definition: This group comprises coal, a combustible black (hard coal) and brownish-black (brown coal) rock consisting of more than 50% by weight and more than 70% by volume of carbonaceous material. It is formed from plant remains that have been compacted, hardened and chemically altered, and metamorphosed by heat and pressure over geologic time.

children.label: Hard coal
children.definition: This class comprises black coal ranked as hard coal, which includes anthracite and bituminous coal. Hard coal refers to coal of gross calorific value equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis and with a mean random reflectance of vitrinite of at least 0.6%.

children.label: Anthracite
children.definition: This subclass comprises anthracite, a high rank hard, lustrous black coal destined primarily for residential and industrial (as steel making) or commercial applications. It has generally less than 10% volatile matter and a high carbon content (about 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

children.label: Anthracite
children.definition: High rank hard lustrous black coal destined primarily for residential and industrial (as steel making) or commercial applications. It has generally less than 10% volatile matter and a high carbon content (about 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

children.label: Bituminous coal
children.definition: This subclass comprises coking or metallurgical coal and other bituminous coal. Bituminous coal is a medium rank coal used for gasification, industrial coking and heat raising, and residential heat raising. It is characterized by higher volatile matter than anthracite (more than 10%) and lower carbon content (less than 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

children.label: Coking (metallurgical) coal
children.definition: Bituminous coal with a quality that allows the production of a coke suitable to support a blast furnace charge. Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

children.label: Other bituminous coal
children.definition: Other bituminous coal mainly used for steam raising purposes. It is characterized by higher volatile matter than anthracite (more than 10%) and lower carbon content (less than 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

children.label: Brown coal
children.definition: This class comprises softer brown coal, which includes sub-bituminous coal and lignite. Brown coal refers to coal of gross calorific value of less than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis, and a mean random reflectance of vitrinite of less than 0.6%.

children.label: Sub-bituminous coal
children.definition: This subclass comprises sub-bituminous coal, a non-agglomerating coal with a gross calorific value equal to or greater than 20,000 kJ/kg and less than 24,000 kJ/kg, containing more than 31% volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

children.label: Sub-bituminous coal
children.definition: Non-agglomerating coal with a gross calorific value equal to or greater than 20,000 kJ/kg and less than 24,000 kJ/kg, containing more than 31% volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

children.label: Lignite
children.definition: This subclass comprises lignite, a non-agglomerating coal with a gross calorific value less than 20,000 kJ/kg, containing more than 31% volatile matter on a dry mineral matter free basis.

children.label: Cannabis products
children.definition: This group comprises cannabis viable seeds and vegetative plants; fresh and dried cannabis (buds and leaves); cannabis oil; other cannabis extracts and concentrates; cannabis-infused edible products; and other cannabis products n.e.c., for non-medical (recreational, wellness, lifestyle, spiritual, etc.) and medical uses. A plant of the genus Cannabis refers generally to three varieties which are cannabis Sativa, cannabis Indica and cannabis Ruderalis. Sativas and Indicas are the most commonly used cannabis strains for cultivation and propagation. The genetics of the different cannabis strains are widely mixed or cloned to create cannabis hybrids. Cannabis contains a number of active elements, including cannabinoids such as tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or dronabinol, cannabidiol (CBD) and terpenes (aromatic compounds or chemical markers). Cannabis plants containing 0.3% w/w (weight for weight) of THC or less in the flowering tops and leaves - industrial hemp - and their derivatives with the THC concentration of 10 µg/g or less, as well as prescription drugs or pharmaceuticals containing cannabis, are excluded from this group.

children.label: Cannabis seeds and vegetative plants
children.definition: This class comprises cannabis viable seeds and cannabis vegetative plants mainly used for planting or sowing, cultivation and propagation of cannabis bred to contain cannabinoids, in particular THC (more than 0.3% w/w) and CBD, for non-medical (recreational, wellness, lifestyle, spiritual, etc.) and medical uses. Cannabis seeds and vegetative plants are commonly from three varieties which are cannabis Sativa, cannabis Indica and cannabis Ruderalis. Sativas and Indicas are the most commonly used cannabis strains for cultivation and propagation. The genetics of the different cannabis strains are widely mixed or cloned to create cannabis hybrids.

children.label: Cannabis seeds, prepared for retail sale, for non-medical use

To obtain cannabis for medical use, a patient or client generally needs to register with a governmental authority and a holder of a licence for sale of cannabis for medical purposes, and get an authorization (medical document and written order) from an authorized health care practitioner.

children.label: Fresh and dried cannabis flowering tops (including leaves)
children.definition: This class comprises freshly harvested and dried cannabis flowering tops, including leaves, for non-medical and medical uses. They contain cannabinoids, in particular THC (more than 0.3% w/w) and CBD. Fresh cannabis refers to fresh or water-rich flowering tops (buds) and leaves, of female plants, that have not been subjected to any drying process. Dried cannabis (also called marijuana, pot or weed) refers to harvested cannabis fresh flowering tops and leaves that have been subjected to drying and irradiation processes, but not further processed.

children.label: Prefabricated buildings and components thereof
children.definition:
This group comprises prefabricated buildings that are built in a factory or manufacturing facility and delivered to the construction site, and the components of prefabricated buildings built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated (factory-built) buildings are virtually complete and either unassembled or fully assembled (or manufactured) and ready to use; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

A building refers to any roofed independent free-standing permanent construction or structure usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof and comprises one or more rooms or other space. A building can be entered or accessed by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building can also include a separately usable underground construction.

A residential building refers to a construction in which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or dwelling purposes.

A non-residential building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for non-residential purposes.

children.label: Prefabricated metal buildings and other non-wood buildings, and components thereof
children.definition: This class comprises prefabricated buildings, predominantly made of metal and other non-wood material, and their components, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) metal and non-wood buildings are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Components of these buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

children.label: Prefabricated metal buildings and components thereof
children.definition: This subclass comprises prefabricated industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings, predominantly made of metal, and their components, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) metal buildings are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Components of buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

Components of those buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site.

children.label: Manufactured (mobile) buildings
children.definition: This class comprises manufactured (mobile) buildings. They refer to prefabricated (factory-built) mobile buildings of any material, in full, although some manufacturers offer these buildings in two sections. Manufactured (mobile) buildings are fully assembled when they leave the factory, often ready to move in or use the same day or few days after arriving on the site. They can be relocated although most, in housing, are never moved from their original site. Manufactured (mobile) buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

They can be relocated although most homes are never moved from their original site.

children.label: Licensing of rights for commercial use of game software

children.label: Licensing of rights for commercial use of game software
children.definition: Licences to use game software or software components to generate revenues.

children.label: General application software (except game software) and software licensing

children.label: General application software (except game software and commercial use licences)
children.definition: This subclass comprises published general application software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), on physical media or in downloadable formats.

children.definition: This subclass comprises licences to use general application software or software components to generate revenues.

children.label: Licensing of rights for commercial use of general application software (except game software)
children.definition: Licences to use general application software or software components to generate revenues.

children.label: Transportation of commodities by pipeline
children.definition: This group comprises transportation of natural gas, crude oil, refined petroleum products and other commodities by pipeline.

children.label: Transportation of natural gas by pipeline
children.definition: This class comprises transportation by pipeline of natural gas.

children.label: Transportation of natural gas by pipeline
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of natural gas.

children.label: Transportation of natural gas by pipeline
children.definition: Transportation by pipeline of natural gas.

children.label: Transportation of crude oil and other commodities by pipeline
children.definition: This class comprises transportation by pipeline of crude oil, refined petroleum products and other commodities.

children.label: Transportation of crude oil by pipeline
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of crude oil and pentanes plus, as well as pipeline transportation of crude bitumen.

children.label: Transportation of crude oil by pipeline
children.definition: Transportation by pipeline of crude oil and pentanes plus, as well as pipeline transportation of crude bitumen.

children.label: Transportation of refined petroleum products by pipeline (including liquid petroleum gases)
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of refined petroleum products, including liquid petroleum gases.

children.label: Transportation of refined petroleum products by pipeline (including liquid petroleum gases)
children.definition: Transportation by pipeline of refined petroleum products, including liquid petroleum gases.

children.label: Transportation of other commodities by pipeline
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of other commodities.

children.label: Freight transportation by road
children.definition: This group comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles (including rental and leasing with operator or driver), for general and specialized freight.

children.label: Road transportation services for general freight
children.definition: This class comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for goods not requiring climate control, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of general freight, is included.

children.label: Road transportation services for general freight
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for goods not requiring climate control, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of general freight, is included.

children.label: Road transportation services for general freight (except rental and operating leasing with operator)
children.definition: Transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for goods not requiring climate control, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers. Rental of trucks with operator is not included.

children.label: Rental of road transportation vehicles with operator, for general freight
children.definition: Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles, with operator or driver, for road transportation of general freight.

children.label: Road transportation services for specialized freight
children.definition: This class comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for specialized freight such as bulk liquids and gases; climate-controlled boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; live animals; waste without collection; dry bulk; and other goods that are not packed, large items and loose goods that are contained only by the vehicle in which they are carried. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of specialized freight, is included.

children.label: Transportation of bulk liquids and gases by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of bulk liquids or gases by road. Covers transportation of bulk liquids and gases that must be temperature-controlled or pressurized.

children.label: Transportation of bulk liquids and gases by road
children.definition: Transportation of bulk liquids or gases by road. Covers transportation of bulk liquids and gases that must be temperature-controlled or pressurized.

children.label: Transportation of climate-controlled boxed, palletized and other packed goods by road (including in intermodal containers)
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by road of goods that must be kept within given ranges of temperature and humidity, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers.

children.label: Transportation of climate-controlled boxed, palletized and other packed goods by road (including in intermodal containers)
children.definition: Transportation by road of goods that must be kept within given ranges of temperature and humidity, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers.

children.label: Transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road.

children.label: Transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road
children.definition: Transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road.

children.label: Transportation of live animals by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of live animals by road.

children.label: Transportation of live animals by road
children.definition: Transportation of live animals by road.

children.label: Transportation of waste, without collection, by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of waste, without collection, by road.

children.label: Transportation of waste, without collection, by road
children.definition: Transportation of waste, without collection, by road.

children.label: Transportation of dry bulk by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of dry bulk commodities by road.

children.label: Transportation of dry bulk by road
children.definition: Transportation of dry bulk commodities by road.

children.label: Transportation of other goods by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by road of goods n.e.c. Covers transportation of goods that are not packed, large items, and loose goods that are contained only by the vehicle in which they are carried.

children.label: Transportation of other goods by road
children.definition: Transportation by road of goods n.e.c. Covers transportation of goods that are not packed, large items, and loose goods that are contained only by the vehicle in which they are carried.

children.label: Rental of road transportation vehicles with operator, for specialized freight
children.definition: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of trucks and other motorized road vehicles, with operator or driver, for road transportation of specialized freight.

children.label: Rental of road transportation vehicles with operator, for specialized freight
children.definition: Rental or leasing of trucks and other motorized road vehicles, with operator or driver, for road transportation of specialized freight.

children.label: Other freight transportation services and air specialty services
children.definition: This group comprises transportation services (including rental and leasing with operator or crew) such as rail, water and air freight; moving services; and air specialty services.

children.label: Rail freight transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises transportation by rail of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of rail equipment with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

children.label: Rail freight transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by rail of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of rail equipment with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

children.label: Rail freight transportation services (except rental and leasing with operator or crew)
children.definition: Transportation by rail of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods.

children.label: Rental and leasing of locomotives and freight rail cars, with operator or crew
children.definition: Rental or leasing services of locomotives and rail cars, with operator or crew, for transportation of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods.

children.label: Water freight transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises transportation by water of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of water vessels with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

children.label: Water freight transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by water of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of water vessels with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

children.label: Water freight transportation services (except rental and leasing with operator or crew)
children.definition: Transportation by water of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods.

children.label: Rental and leasing of freight vessels with operator or crew
children.definition: Rental or leasing services of all types of self-propelled freight vessels for coastal, transoceanic and inland water transport, with operator or crew, for the transportation of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods.

children.label: Air freight transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises transportation by air of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space. Rental and leasing services of cargo or freight aircraft with operator or crew, are included.

children.label: Air freight transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation by air of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space. Rental and leasing services of cargo or freight aircraft with operator or crew, are included.

children.label: Air freight transportation services (except rental and leasing with operator or crew)
children.definition: Transportation by air of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space.

children.label: Rental and leasing of freight aircraft, with operator or crew
children.definition: Rental or leasing of dedicated cargo or freight aircraft, with operator or crew (''wet leasing'' and ''damp leasing''), for the transportation of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space. The service may include providing fuel. Renter or lessee generally has operational control of the flight. The period of the rental or lease can go from one month to usually one to two years. Everything less than one month can be considered as ad-hoc charter services.

children.label: Moving services
children.definition: This class comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of household, office and institutional goods, and goods requiring special handling and protection. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Household moving services
children.definition: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of personal effects and property to be used in a dwelling. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Household moving services
children.definition: Removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of personal effects and property to be used in a dwelling. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Commercial moving services
children.definition: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of furniture, fixtures, equipment and other property, but not stock-in-trade, of stores, offices, museums, institutions, hospitals and other establishments. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Commercial moving services
children.definition: Removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of furniture, fixtures, equipment and other property, but not stock-in-trade, of stores, offices, museums, institutions, hospitals and other establishments. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Institutional and other moving services
children.definition: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of goods requiring special handling and protection, such as objects of art, antiques, pianos, displays and exhibits when not part of a household or commercial move. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Institutional and other moving services
children.definition: Removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of goods requiring special handling and protection, such as objects of art, antiques, pianos, displays and exhibits when not part of a household or commercial move. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Air specialty services
children.definition: This class comprises the provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

children.label: Air specialty services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

children.label: Air specialty services
children.definition: Provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

children.label: Postal and courier services
children.definition: This group comprises postal services; and courier, parcel, and local messenger and delivery services.

children.label: Postal services
children.definition: This class comprises delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Postal services
children.definition: This subclass comprises delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Postal services
children.definition: Delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Courier, parcel, and local messenger and delivery services
children.definition: This class comprises station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking; courier and messenger services; and neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items.

children.label: Station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of small packages and documents without tracking of each package and document. Service is typically station-to-station but may be door-to-door. Transportation is provided on passenger buses and trains according to published schedules but departure and arrival times are not guaranteed. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking
children.definition: Transportation of small packages and documents without tracking of each package and document. Service is typically station-to-station but may be door-to-door. Transportation is provided on passenger buses and trains according to published schedules but departure and arrival times are not guaranteed. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Courier and messenger services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation and delivery, by a definite day and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Same-day courier and messenger services
children.definition: Transportation and delivery, on the same day as pick-up and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery on the day or by the specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Next-day courier and messenger services
children.definition: Transportation and delivery, on the first business day or first calendar day following pick-up, and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Second-day or later courier and messenger services
children.definition: Transportation and delivery, on the second business day or second calendar day following pick-up, or on a later specified day, and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

children.label: Neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items
children.definition: This subclass comprises door-to-door transportation and delivery of small purchased and serviced items such as take-out meals, groceries, prescription drugs and dry-cleaned clothes. Service is limited to a specified neighbourhood. Delivery is made immediately after the item is purchased or ordered, or scheduled within a short time. Expected delivery time is made known to the recipient. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service.

children.label: Neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items
children.definition: Door-to-door transportation and delivery of small purchased and serviced items such as take-out meals, groceries, prescription drugs and dry-cleaned clothes. Service is limited to a specified neighbourhood. Delivery is made immediately after the item is purchased or ordered, or scheduled within a short time. Expected delivery time is made known to the recipient. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service.

children.label: Passenger transportation services (including sightseeing)
children.definition: This group comprises urban transit services; taxi and limousine services; interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services; school bus services; other transit and passenger transportation services by road; rail passenger transportation services; water passenger transportation services; air passenger transportation services; and scenic and sightseeing tour services. Rental and leasing services of passenger vehicles with operator, driver or crew are included.

children.label: Urban transit services
children.definition: This class comprises passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Urban transit services
children.definition: This subclass comprises passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Urban transit services
children.definition: Passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Taxi and limousine services
children.definition: This class comprises local limousine services; local taxi services and taxi dispatch services.

children.label: Local limousine services
children.definition: This subclass comprises local passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation, or without reservation to passengers as they leave an airport or other transportation terminal. In the case of travel from an airport or other transportation terminal, the fee is on the basis of the distance to the destination, calculated on a zone basis; there may be a minimum charge. In other cases, the fee charged is on the basis of the length of time for which the vehicle is reserved; there is normally a minimum length of time and/or a minimum tariff. The vehicle and driver are available to make a series of trips as directed by the customer during the period for which the vehicle has been reserved.

children.label: Local limousine services
children.definition: Local passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation, or without reservation to passengers as they leave an airport or other transportation terminal. In the case of travel from an airport or other transportation terminal, the fee is on the basis of the distance to the destination, calculated on a zone basis; there may be a minimum charge. In other cases, the fee charged is on the basis of the length of time for which the vehicle is reserved; there is normally a minimum length of time and/or a minimum tariff. The vehicle and driver are available to make a series of trips as directed by the customer during the period for which the vehicle has been reserved.

children.label: Local taxi services and taxi dispatch services
children.definition: This subclass comprises passenger transportation by automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available on demand. The fee charged to passengers is on the basis of distance travelled. Also comprises taxi dispatch services.

children.label: Local taxi services
children.definition: Passenger transportation by automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available on demand. The fee charged to passengers is on the basis of distance travelled.

children.label: Dispatch services for taxi and ridesharing, including online
children.definition: Dispatch services for taxi and ridesharing, including online.

children.label: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

children.label: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

children.label: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
children.definition: Long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

children.label: School bus services
children.definition: This class comprises transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: School bus services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: School bus services
children.definition: Transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Other transit and passenger transportation services by road
children.definition: This class comprises long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus; local passenger transportation by chartered bus; other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route); shuttle service; other local fixed route passenger transportation service by road; special needs urban transit service; and local shared-ride passenger transportation service. Rental or leasing services of road passenger transportation vehicles with operator or driver are included.

children.label: Long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus
children.definition: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

children.label: Long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus
children.definition: Long distance passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

children.label: Local passenger transportation by chartered bus
children.definition: This subclass comprises local passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

children.label: Local passenger transportation by chartered bus
children.definition: Local passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

children.label: Other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route)
children.definition: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

children.label: Other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route)
children.definition: Long distance passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

children.label: Shuttle services
children.definition: This subclass comprises passenger transportation operated on regular routes and on regular schedules or on regular routes on an unscheduled but frequent basis. Service is typically between a limited number of pick-up and drop-off points, with no local service for other points along the route; or on a circular route with frequent stops. The service is not part of a network. As many passengers as can be accommodated are carried on a first-come first-served basis. Passengers may or may not be charged a per-trip fee. Covers shuttle service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Shuttle services
children.definition: Passenger transportation operated on regular routes and on regular schedules or on regular routes on an unscheduled but frequent basis. Service is typically between a limited number of pick-up and drop-off points, with no local service for other points along the route; or on a circular route with frequent stops. The service is not part of a network. As many passengers as can be accommodated are carried on a first-come first-served basis. Passengers may or may not be charged a per-trip fee. Covers shuttle service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Other local fixed route passenger transportation services by road
children.definition: This subclass comprises local fixed route passenger transportation service by road except urban transit service, transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis, and shuttle service. Covers employee transportation to work arranged by the employer and operated on regular routes and schedules. Vehicles used are typically buses but may be smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may be accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers employee transportation to work whether paid for by passengers or by contracts. Carpool transportation is provided by arranging and administering pools and providing a vehicle to members of each pool in exchange for a monthly fee to cover operating costs. One or more pool members must act as driver.

children.label: Other local fixed route passenger transportation services by road
children.definition: Local fixed route passenger transportation service by road except urban transit service, transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis, and shuttle service. Covers employee transportation to work arranged by the employer and operated on regular routes and schedules. Vehicles used are typically buses but may be smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may be accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers employee transportation to work whether paid for by passengers or by contracts. Carpool transportation is provided by arranging and administering pools and providing a vehicle to members of each pool in exchange for a monthly fee to cover operating costs. One or more pool members must act as driver.

children.label: Special needs urban transit services
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of passengers who have physical or cognitive impairments that make them unable to use regular urban transit. Transportation is by shared vans, minibuses or automobiles, is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only to registered passengers by reservation. Passengers are transported to and from their individual homes, workplaces and other locations. Passengers are charged a per-trip fee. Covers special needs urban transit service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Special needs urban transit services
children.definition: Transportation of passengers who have physical or cognitive impairments that make them unable to use regular urban transit. Transportation is by shared vans, minibuses or automobiles, is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only to registered passengers by reservation. Passengers are transported to and from their individual homes, workplaces and other locations. Passengers are charged a per-trip fee. Covers special needs urban transit service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

children.label: Local shared-ride passenger transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises local shared-ride service, that is, local shared passenger transportation operated on request, typically between an airport and homes, offices or hotels specified by passengers. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

children.label: Local shared-ride passenger transportation services
children.definition: Local shared-ride service, that is, local shared passenger transportation operated on request, typically between an airport and homes, offices or hotels specified by passengers. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

children.label: Rental of road passenger transportation vehicles, with operator
children.definition: This subclass comprises rental or operating leasing services of passenger automobiles and light vans with operator or driver, that is, chauffeur-driven car-hire services, wherever delivered, generally supplied on a time basis to a limited number of passengers and frequently involving transportation to more than one destination. Also comprises rental or operating leasing services of buses or coaches with operator or driver for a period of time, not generally dependent on distance. The renter defines how and when the vehicles will be operated, determining schedules, routes, and other operational considerations.

children.label: Rental of passenger automobiles and light vans, with operator
children.definition: Rental or operating leasing services of passenger automobiles and light vans with operator or driver, that is, chauffeur-driven car-hire services, wherever delivered, generally supplied on a time basis to a limited number of passengers and frequently involving transportation to more than one destination.

children.label: Rental of buses and coaches, with operator
children.definition: Rental or operating leasing services of buses or coaches with operator or driver for a period of time, not generally dependent on distance. The renter defines how and when the vehicles will be operated, determining schedules, routes, and other operational considerations.

children.label: Rail passenger transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises interurban transportation of passengers by rail.

children.label: Rail passenger transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises interurban transportation of passengers by rail.

children.label: Passenger rail transportation services, business class
children.definition: Interurban transportation of passengers by rail, with premium-quality amenities, without sleeping facilities. The fare is not subject to advance purchase requirements or restrictions on exchanges or refunds. Covers the transport of accompanying luggage and other items as well as sales to passengers and bulk purchases by tour operators of seats for resale; exclusive and non-exclusive car usage; and scheduled and non-scheduled services. May include a segment where transportation is by bus. Covers service paid for with a ticket or voucher from a book of tickets, or with a train pass.

children.label: Passenger rail transportation services, economy/discounted economy classes
children.definition: Interurban transportation of passengers by rail, with standard-quality amenities, without sleeping facilities. Food and beverages are available at an extra charge. Covers both economy and discounted economy classes; the latter offers the same amenities as the economy class but contains restrictions such as advance purchase and penalty charges for exchanges and refunds. Covers the transport of accompanying luggage and other items as well as sales to passengers and bulk purchases by tour operators of seats for resale; exclusive and non-exclusive car usage; and scheduled and non-scheduled services. May include a segment where transportation is by bus. Covers service paid for with a ticket or voucher from a book of tickets, or with a train pass.

children.label: Passenger rail transportation services, sleeper class
children.definition: Interurban transportation of passengers by rail, with accommodation in sleeping cars and premium-quality amenities. Covers the transport of accompanying luggage and other items as well as sales to passengers and bulk purchases by tour operators of seats for resale; exclusive and non-exclusive car usage; and scheduled and non-scheduled services. May include a segment where transportation is by bus. Covers service paid for with a ticket or voucher from a book of tickets, or with a train pass.

children.label: Private rail car hitching
children.definition: Hitching of a privately-owned or rented rail car to a train. No services are provided inside the rail car.

children.label: Water passenger transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises coastal and Great Lakes fixed route passenger transportation services by water; and other passenger transportation services by water. Rental and leasing services of water passenger transportation vessels with operator or crew are included.

children.label: Water passenger transportation services (except rental with operator)
children.definition: This subclass comprises coastal and Great Lakes fixed route passenger transportation services by water; and other passenger transportation services by water.

children.label: Coastal and Great Lakes fixed route passenger transportation services by water
children.definition: Transportation of passengers by water on fixed routes on coastal waters, the Great Lakes, the St. Lawrence Seaway or deep seas. Covers transportation of motor vehicles, baggage and sporting equipment accompanying passengers as well as optional accommodation such as cabin, berth or reclining sleeper seat.

children.label: Other passenger transportation services by water
children.definition: Transportation of passengers by water on fixed routes within harbours, transportation of passengers by water on fixed routes on inland waters except the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence Seaway, and transportation of passengers by water, not on fixed routes. Service may operate on a regular schedule or on demand. Service that is not on fixed routes often requires advance reservation.

children.label: Rental of water transportation equipment with operator
children.definition: This subclass comprises rental or leasing services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for coastal, transoceanic and inland water transport, with operator or crew.

children.label: Rental of water transportation equipment with operator
children.definition: Rental or leasing services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for coastal, transoceanic and inland water transport, with operator or crew.

children.label: Air passenger transportation services
children.definition: This class comprises scheduled and chartered air passenger transportation services. Rental and leasing of passenger aircraft with operator or crew (wet and damp leasing) are included.

children.label: Scheduled air passenger transportation services (except wet and damp leasing)
children.definition: This subclass comprises transportation of passengers by air on a flight operated on a regular basis according to a published timetable.

children.label: Scheduled air passenger transportation services, domestic
children.definition: Transportation of passengers by air on a domestic scheduled flight.

children.label: Scheduled air passenger transportation services, international
children.definition: Transportation of passengers by air on an international scheduled flight.

children.label: Air passenger charter transportation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises rental and leasing of complete aircraft and crew, for the chartered or non-scheduled transportation of passengers and their accompanying baggage, equipment and supplies. Renters or lessees generally do not have operational control of the flights. Air charter services include air taxi, ad hoc air charter, frequent charter membership and full charter services. Full (public) air charter is a long-term renting of an entire aircraft, usually undertaken by tour operators, that require aircraft on a seasonal basis, but do not have the required infrastructure to operate their own aircraft.

children.label: Air passenger charter transportation services, domestic
children.definition: Rental and leasing of complete aircraft and crew, for the non-scheduled transportation of passengers and their accompanying baggage, equipment and supplies, within Canada. Covers positioning fees, layover fees, and pilot standby fees. Renters or lessees generally do not have operational control of the flights.

children.label: Air passenger charter transportation services, international
children.definition: Rental and leasing of complete aircraft and crew, for the non-scheduled transportation of passengers and their accompanying baggage, equipment and supplies, between Canada and other countries. Covers positioning fees, layover fees, and pilot standby fees. Renters or lessees generally do not have operational control of the flights.

children.label: Rental and leasing of passenger aircraft with operator or crew (except chartering)
children.definition: This subclass comprises rental and leasing services of passenger aircraft or aircraft suitable for passenger and freight (including helicopters) with operator or crew (wet and damp leasing). A ''wet lease'' is a leasing arrangement whereby one "airline" or aircraft operator (the lessor) provides an aircraft, complete crew (''damp lease'' is with only cockpit crew), maintenance, and insurance (ACMI). These services are generally supplied on a time basis and several different destinations are frequently involved. The services may include providing fuel. Renters or lessees generally have operational control of the flights. The period of the rental or lease can go from one month to usually one to two years. Everything less than one month can be considered as ad-hoc charter services.

children.label: Rental and leasing of passenger aircraft with operator or crew (except chartering)
children.definition: Rental and leasing services of passenger aircraft or aircraft suitable for passenger and freight (including helicopters) with operator or crew (wet and damp leasing). A ''wet lease'' is a leasing arrangement whereby one "airline" or aircraft operator (the lessor) provides an aircraft, complete crew (''damp lease'' is with only cockpit crew), maintenance, and insurance (ACMI). These services are generally supplied on a time basis and several different destinations are frequently involved. The services may include providing fuel. Renters or lessees generally have operational control of the flights. The period of the rental or lease can go from one month to usually one to two years. Everything less than one month can be considered as ad-hoc charter services.

children.label: Scenic and sightseeing tour services
children.definition: This class comprises services which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest by rail, buses and other ground vehicles, water, and air, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment that is an attraction in itself. May include commentary, admission to sights or guided visits. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

children.label: Sightseeing services by rail
children.definition: This subclass comprises services by rail which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment such as steam trains, cog railways and monorails. May include commentary, admission to sights, guided visits, meals or entertainment. Covers dining trips and theatre trips. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

children.label: Residential buildings
children.definition:
This group comprises residential buildings.

A residential building refers to a construction in which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or private dwelling purposes, whether on a permanent basis or not. Residential buildings normally provide accommodation units or residential building units with self-contained and exclusive use of bathroom and kitchen facilities to the occupants of each unit. At least half of the useful floor area must be used or intended for dwelling units, in the case of apartment buildings. A residential building unit is a structurally separated and independent place.
A group of three row houses that are attached is considered to be three separate buildings if their external walls or dividing walls extend from the foundations to the roof.

Residential buildings constructed entirely at the building site, as well as on-site fully assembled precast, panelized, modular and other prefabricated residential buildings are included in this group. Unassembled prefabricated residential buildings built in a factory, and manufactured or fully assembled residential buildings built in a factory and delivered ready for move-in, are excluded from this group.

A building for which the majority of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for dwelling units with shared bathroom and kitchen, or that area is used primarily to offer care and other assisted living services, is classified as a "collective dwelling-type building" under the non-residential buildings group.

A building refers to any independent free-standing permanent structure comprising one or more residential dwelling units, business units or other spaces. A building can be entered by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building is covered by a roof and is usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof. In the case of interconnected structures (e.g., semi-detached or terraced houses), any unit separated from other units by a fire wall extending from roof to cellar is considered an individual building. If there is no fire wall, the interconnected building units are regarded as individual buildings if they have their own access (own entrance) as well as their own utility system and are separately usable.

Unassembled prefabricated residential buildings built in a factory, and manufactured or fully assembled residential buildings built in a factory and delivered ready for move-in, are excluded from this group.

A building for which the majority of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for dwelling units with shared bathroom and kitchen, or that area is used primarily to offer care and other assisted living services, is classified as a "collective dwelling-type building" under the non-residential buildings group.

A building refers to any independent free-standing permanent structure comprising one or more residential dwelling units, business units or other spaces. A building can be entered by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building is covered by a roof and is usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof. In the case of interconnected structures (e.g., semi-detached or terraced houses), any unit separated from other units by a fire wall extending from roof to cellar is considered an individual building. If there is no fire wall, the interconnected building units are regarded as individual buildings if they have their own access (own entrance) as well as their own utility system and are separately usable.

children.label: Residential buildings of five or more storeys
children.definition: This subclass comprises residential buildings of five or more storeys. A residential building of five or more storeys refers to such a building of which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or dwelling purposes. A residential building also generally provides accommodation units with self-contained and exclusive use of bathroom and kitchen facilities to the occupants of the apartments, condominiums or other types of dwellings in the building. These types of buildings do not provide care or other assisted daily living services; they provide private dwellings for at least half of the overall useful floor area of the building.

children.label: Residential buildings of five or more storeys
children.definition: Residential buildings of five or more storeys.

children.label: Residential buildings of fewer than five storeys
children.definition: This subclass comprises residential buildings of fewer than five storeys. A residential building of five or more storeys refers to such a building of which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or dwelling purposes. A residential building also generally provides accommodation units with self-contained and exclusive use of bathroom and kitchen facilities to the occupants of the apartments, condominiums or other types of dwellings in the building. These types of buildings do not provide care or other assisted daily living services; they provide private dwellings for at least half of the overall useful floor area of the building.

children.label: Single-detached houses
children.definition: Single dwellings not attached to any other dwelling or structure (except their own garage or shed) that have open space on all sides and have no dwellings either above them or below them.

children.label: Semi-detached houses
children.definition: Two dwellings attached side by side (or back to back) to each other, but not attached to any other dwelling or structure (except their own garage or shed), that have no dwellings either above them or below them. The two units together have open space on all sides.

children.label: Row houses
children.definition: Row houses refer to row of three or more attached, one-family dwellings, each built with similar architectural treatment, separated by vertical divisions termed "party" or "lot-line" walls, and each having private entrances (usually both front and rear). Also a group of apartments, usually row-oriented, where each one is like a separate "house" and is usually two storeys. It generally refers to such units in an urban area and they are often condominiums. Often referred to as "townhouses".

children.label: Non-residential buildings
children.definition:
This group comprises non-residential buildings.

A non-residential building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for non-residential purposes, namely for industrial, commercial or institutional purposes, including for the provision of services. A non-residential building unit is a structurally separated and independent place.

Non-residential buildings constructed entirely at the building site, as well as on-site fully assembled precast, panelized, modular and other prefabricated non-residential buildings are included in this group. Unassembled prefabricated non-residential buildings built in a factory, and manufactured or fully assembled non-residential buildings built in a factory and delivered ready for move-in, are excluded from this group.

A building for which more than half of the useful floor area is used or intended for dwelling units or accommodation units with shared bathroom and kitchen, or that area is used primarily to offer care and other assisted living services, is classified as a "collective dwelling-type building" in this group.

A building refers to any roofed independent free-standing permanent construction or structure usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof and comprises one or more rooms or other space. A building can be entered or accessed by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building can also include a separately usable underground construction. In the case of interconnected structures, any unit separated from other units by a fire wall extending from roof to cellar is considered an individual building. If there is no fire wall, the interconnected building units are regarded as individual buildings if they have their own access or entrance, as well as their own utility system and are separately usable.

children.label: Research and experimental development services
children.definition: This group comprises research and experimental development services in natural sciences, engineering and technology, medical and health sciences, agricultural and veterinary sciences, social sciences, and humanities and the arts. Research and experimental development (R&D) comprise creative and systemic work undertaken in order to increase the stock of knowledge - including knowledge of humankind, culture and society - and to devise new applications of available knowledge. The term R&D refers to three types of activity: basic research, applied research and experimental development. Basic research refers to experimental or theoretical work undertaken primarily to acquire new knowledge of the underlying foundations of phenomena and observable facts, without any particular application or use in view. Applied research refers to original investigation undertaken in order to acquire new knowledge. It is, however, directed primarily towards a specific, practical aim or objective. Experimental development is systematic work, drawing on knowledge gained from research and practical experience and producing additional knowledge, which is directed to producing new products or processes or to improving existing products or processes.
