Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

children.label: Sponsorship rights
children.definition: Granting the right to associate specific goods or services, or a corporation or other entity, with an activity, product or project carried out by another party. Sponsorships usually include the provision of advertising display space and may include exclusivity rights.

children.label: Endorsement services

children.label: Product placement

children.label: Advertising space on billboards, transit and other displays

children.label: Advertising intermediary services

children.label: Advertising intermediary services
children.definition: This subclass comprises services of intermediaries in the buying and selling of advertising space and time, more specifically the services of acquiring advertising space or time from media owners, for sale to advertisers or advertising agencies; and services of intermediaries in selling advertising space or time in various media for a fee or commission paid by the media outlet.

children.label: Advertising intermediary services

children.label: Direct advertising services
children.definition: This class comprises advertising and marketing services that communicate directly with the consumers, without using time or space in media outlets such as newspaper or television. It covers advertising and marketing campaigns communicated by direct mail, door-to-door delivery, distribution of samples in public places, use of advertising specialties, product demonstrations and display lettering. This class also covers full service direct mail advertisement and full service direct advertising.

children.label: Direct advertising services, sold separately
children.definition: This subclass comprises advertising and marketing services, sold separately, that communicate directly with the consumers, without using time or space in media outlets such as newspaper or television. It covers advertising and marketing campaigns communicated by direct mail, door-to-door delivery, distribution of samples in public places, use of advertising specialties, product demonstrations and display lettering.

children.label: Advertising specialty services, sold separately
children.definition: Services of intermediaries between purchasers and producers of advertising specialties (key chains, magnets, mouse pads, mugs, etc.) bearing promotional material of the purchasing businesses. Services included here are not bundled with other advertising services.

children.label: Direct mail advertising services, sold separately
children.definition: Direct advertising services sold separately where the advertiser communicates directly with consumers by mail (including email). Such services include concept development services for direct mail advertising campaign, letter shop services, selling custom mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, proofreading direct mailout package materials, editing and formatting client-supplied mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, receiving and making telephone calls related to direct mail campaign.

children.label: Distribution of advertising materials, other than by mail, provided separately
children.definition: Services of distributing advertising materials by methods other than mail (except when bundled with other advertising services).

children.label: Product or merchandise demonstrations, provided separately
children.definition: Services of demonstrating the uses or benefits of a product or merchandise in a public place (except when bundled with other advertising services).

children.label: Display lettering services, sold separately
children.definition: Display lettering services (except when bundled with other advertising services).

children.label: Full service direct mail advertising
children.definition: This subclass comprises all the services required for a direct mail advertising campaign, from the concept development through the actual mailout (including emailing). Services include implementing a bundle of direct mail advertising methods, such as concept development services for direct mail advertising campaign, letter shop services, selling custom mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, proofreading direct mailout package materials, editing and formatting client-supplied mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, receiving and making telephone calls related to direct mail campaign. Generally, the direct mail advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

children.label: Full service direct mail advertising

Generally, the direct mail advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

children.label: Full service direct advertising
children.definition: This subclass comprises all services required for developing a comprehensive strategy to send promotional messages directly to consumers, except via mass media. Services include implementing a bundle of marketing or advertising methods, such as telemarketing, distribution of advertising materials and advertising specialties, other than by mail, direct mail, product demonstrations and display lettering. Generally, the direct advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

children.label: Fixed retail telecommunications services (except Internet access)
children.definition: This subclass comprises telephone services to end users where calls originate from a device connected to a landline.

children.label: Fixed local and access telecommunications services (except Internet access), at retail
children.definition: A landline-based telephone service that allows end users to make calls within a defined local area and provides access to a long distance network of the customer's choice.

children.label: Fixed long distance telecommunications services (except Internet access), at retail
children.definition: A landline-based telephone service allowing end users to make calls outside a local calling area.

children.label: Data transmission services
children.definition: Telecommunications services making use of data protocols to transmit data over a public network.

children.label: Private network services
children.definition: Telecommunications network segments for the exclusive use of the client on which no control or signalling is performed by the telecommunications service provider.

children.label: Fixed retail Internet access services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of fixed connections (including fixed wireline and wireless) to the Internet to end users.

children.label: Dial-up Internet access services
children.definition: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to end users at download speeds not exceeding 64 Kbps. Dial-up Internet access is one of the oldest forms of Internet access technology. It is also referred to as low or narrowband speed Internet access. Narrowband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of up to 1.5 Mbps.

children.label: Fixed high-speed Internet access services, residential
children.definition: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to residential end users at download speeds generally greater than 256 Kbps. High-speed Internet is also referred to as broadband Internet, with fixed line types such as cable, digital subscriber line (DSL), terrestrial wireless access, direct-to-home satellite access, and fibre optic services. Even though the lowest speed limit for high-speed Internet is set to 256 Kbps in several countries, broadband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of 1.5 Mbps or greater. Connection with download speed from 256 Kbps up to 1.5 Mbps is sometimes referred to as "wideband" or "lite broadband".

children.label: Fixed high-speed Internet access services, non-residential
children.definition: Provision of fixed connections to the Internet to non-residential or business end users at download speeds greater than 256 Kbps. High-speed Internet is also referred to as broadband Internet, with fixed line types such as cable, digital subscriber line (DSL), terrestrial wireless access, direct-to-home satellite access, and fibre optic services. Even though the lowest speed limit for high-speed Internet is set to 256 Kbps in several countries, broadband is generally regarded as a category including any connection with a transmission or download speed of 1.5 Mbps or greater. Connection with download speed from 256 Kbps up to 1.5 Mbps is sometimes referred to as "wideband" or "lite broadband".

children.label: Mobile retail telecommunications services
children.definition: This subclass comprises telecommunication services to end users where voice or data communications originate from, or terminate into, a mobile device connected to a wireless network.

children.label: Mobile local and access telecommunications services, at retail
children.definition: A wireless-based telecommunications service that allows end users to make and receive calls within a defined local area and provides access to a long distance network of the customer's choice. Mobile cell phone plans typically bundle voice and text messaging.

children.label: Mobile long distance telecommunications services, at retail
children.definition: Wireless based telecommunications service allowing end users to make calls outside a local calling area.

children.label: Mobile data services
children.definition: A service plan providing end users mobile access to text and multimedia messaging, along with access to the Internet through the cellular network. This service is also referred as "wireless mobile Internet access", at retail.

children.label: Roaming services
children.definition: A service that allows a cell phone subscriber to use his or her mobile device while in the service area of another service provider.

children.label: Broadcasting and online games distribution services
children.definition: This class comprises broadcast distribution services of audiovisual and audio works such as television programs, films, videos, sound recordings, via cable, satellite, Internet and other fixed and mobile distribution streams. Also covers distribution services for online games, except gambling, and installation services for connections to broadcasting distribution networks.

children.label: Basic television programming packages
children.definition: This subclass comprises basic television programming packages distribution services, via fixed or mobile devices.

children.label: Basic television programming packages (except online streaming)
children.definition: Providing a basic package of movie and television programming services, basically to a fixed device, except using online streaming, for a monthly subscription fee. Basic packages are any first level programming package that must be purchased before being able to purchase additional programming packages. The basic programming packages are delivered using traditional over-the-air (OTA), cable and satellite television.

children.label: Online streaming of basic programming packages
children.definition: Providing a basic package of movie and television programming services over the Internet, to a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming, for a monthly subscription fee. Basic packages are any first level programming package that must be purchased before being able to purchase additional programming packages.

children.label: Discretionary television programming packages
children.definition: This subclass comprises discretionary television programming packages distribution services, via fixed or mobile devices.

children.label: Discretionary programming packages (except online streaming)
children.definition: Providing movie and television programming services, in addition to those included in a basic package, for an additional monthly subscription fee, generally to a fixed device, except using online streaming. This programming service comprises bundles of channels or à la carte channels. The discretionary television programming packages are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

children.label: Online streaming of discretionary programming packages
children.definition: Providing movie and television programming services over the Internet, in addition to those included in a basic package, for an additional monthly subscription fee, to a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming. This programming service comprises bundles of channels or à la carte channels.

children.label: Pay-per-view services
children.definition: This subclass comprises pay-per-view services, via fixed or mobile devices. The broadcaster shows a pay-per-view program at the same broadcast time to everyone ordering it.

children.label: Pay-per-view services (except online streaming)
children.definition: Providing services which enable subscribers to television programming packages, to watch a specific program (movie or event) at the same broadcast time, generally at a fixed device, for an additional fee, except using online streaming. The pay-per-view services are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

children.label: Online streaming of pay-per-view programs
children.definition: Providing services over the Internet which enable subscribers to television programming packages, to watch a specific program (movie or event) at the same broadcast time, on a fixed or mobile device, using online streaming, for an additional fee.

children.label: Television, movie and video on demand services
children.definition: This subclass comprises pay television, movie and other video on demand services (except pay-per-view), via fixed or mobile devices. Subscribers or viewers of video on demand are allowed to choose and watch broadcasts at any time, for a one time fee paid for each individual video that is on demand (transactional video on demand), or for a monthly or annual subscription fee (subscription video on demand) to have unlimited access to television programs, movies and any other types of videos during the time covered by the subscription.

children.label: Television, movie and video on demand (except online streaming)
children.definition: Providing pay television, movie and other video on demand services (except per-pay-view), generally via fixed devices, except using online streaming. Subscribers or viewers to/of video on demand are allowed to choose and watch broadcasts at any time, usually for a one time fee paid for each individual video that is on demand (transactional video on demand). Video on demand services are delivered using traditional cable and satellite television.

children.label: Online on demand streaming of television, movie and video
children.definition: Providing pay television, movie and other video on demand services (except pay-per-view) over the Internet, via fixed or mobile devices, using online streaming. Subscribers or viewers to/of video on demand are allowed to choose and watch broadcasts at any time, usually for a monthly or annual subscription fee (subscription video on demand) to have unlimited access to television programs, movies and any other types of videos during the time covered by the subscription.

children.label: Satellite radio and online audio streaming services
children.definition: This subclass comprises pay satellite radio and online audio (such as music) streaming services.

children.label: Satellite radio services
children.definition: Pay satellite radio services.

children.label: Online audio streaming services
children.definition: Providing programming services (including self-programming), over the Internet, that comprise a single payment (fee) or a subscription, to a selection of radio shows, music and other audio recordings, streamed to fixed and mobile devices (Internet audio services). Subscribers are allowed to choose and stream contents at any time during the time covered by the payment or subscription.

children.label: Online gaming services (except gambling)
children.definition: This subclass comprises provision of various games to be played online, on a subscription or single payment (fee) basis, except gambling. The games are streamed over the Internet to fixed and mobile devices.

children.label: Online gaming services (except gambling)
children.definition: Providing various games to be played online, on a subscription or single payment (fee) basis, except gambling. The games are streamed over the Internet to fixed and mobile devices.

children.label: Installation services for connections to broadcasting distribution networks
children.definition: This subclass comprises services of installing cables on the customer premises and/or installing outlets to connect to the program or broadcasting distribution networks.

children.label: Installation services for connections to broadcasting distribution networks
children.definition: Providing installation of cables on the customer premises and/or installing outlets to connect to the program or broadcasting distribution networks.

children.label: Other information technology (IT) and information services
children.definition: This group comprises data processing, hosting and related services, and other information technology (IT) and information services.

children.label: Data processing, hosting, and related services
children.definition: This class comprises services such as website hosting, application provisioning, business process management, infrastructure provisioning, network management, and information and document transformation.

children.label: Website hosting and domain name registration services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the services of providing the infrastructure to host a customer's website and related files in a location that provides connection to the Internet or make their website accessible via the World Wide Web, and domain name registration services.

children.label: Website hosting services
children.definition: Services of providing the infrastructure to host a customer's website and related files in a location that provides connection to the Internet or make their website accessible via the World Wide Web.

children.label: Domain names registration services
children.definition: Services of providing the registration of a domain name for a customer, by certified registrars and authorized resellers or affiliates.

children.label: Application service provisioning
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of leased software applications from a centralized, hosted, and managed computing environment (including cloud), customized to the needs of individual clients or for multi tenant access.

children.label: Application service provisioning (except software as a service, on cloud)
children.definition: Provision of leased software applications from a centralized, hosted, and managed computing environment, customized to the needs of each clients, except software as a service (SaaS), cloud-based or on demand.

children.label: Software as a service, on cloud
children.definition: Provision of rented or leased software applications over the Internet, from a centralized, Internet-hosted, and managed cloud computing multi tenant environment, where all clients can use the same application, on demand, commonly (not exclusively) on a monthly or an annual fee basis. No installation of the application software is needed for the client.

children.label: Business process management services
children.definition: This subclass comprises a service that analyzes the way a business process is conducted, and identifies improvements that can be made by integrating existing and new software services, in order to improve information flows and increase automation of the process.

children.label: Business process management services
children.definition: Services that analyze the way a business process is conducted, and identifies improvements that can be made by integrating existing and new software services, in order to improve information flows and increase automation of the process.

children.label: Other information technology (IT) infrastructure provisioning services
children.definition: This subclass comprises other information technology (IT) hosting or infrastructure provisioning services such as hosting client's application, processing client's data and computer time share.

children.label: Information technology (IT) infrastructure co-location services (except telecommunications facilities)
children.definition: Information technology (IT) infrastructure co-location services, except telecommunications facilities, which provide storage capacity and Internet connections for rental to multiple retail clients.

children.label: Data storage infrastructure provisioning services
children.definition: Services of providing the infrastructure and the management or administration of the storage and back-up of data.

children.label: Data management infrastructure provisioning services
children.definition: Services of providing the infrastructure and on-going management and administration of data as an organizational resource.

children.label: Video and audio streaming infrastructure provisioning services
children.definition: Services of providing the infrastructure for sending audio and video data over the Internet or providing services to support video and audio streaming over the Internet.

children.label: Infrastructure as a service (except data storage infrastructure provisioning)
children.definition: Infrastructure as a service (except data storage infrastructure provisioning).

children.label: Platform as a service
children.definition: Platform as a service (PaaS), or application platform as a service (aPaaS), refers to a category of cloud computing services that allows customers to provision, run, and manage a modular bundle of one or more applications and based on IT infrastructure as a service.

children.label: Other information technology (IT) infrastructure provisioning services, n.e.c.
children.definition: Other information technology (IT) infrastructure provisioning services, n.e.c.

children.label: Information technology (IT) infrastructure and network management services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the service of managing and monitoring a client's information technology (IT) infrastructure including hardware, software and networks.

children.label: Network management services
children.definition: Services of managing and monitoring communication networks and connected hardware to diagnose networking problems and gather capacity and usage statistics for the administration and fine-tuning of network traffic.

children.label: Computer systems management services
children.definition: Providing day-to-day management and operation of a client's computer system.

children.label: Information and document transformation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of technical expertise and equipment to transform information and documents from one format or media to another.

children.label: Imaging and other data capture services
children.definition: Services of converting paper documents into digital or other machine-readable formats. These services generally involve the following components: document preparation; scanning, optical character recognition, and other data capture activities; and the delivery or output of the information captured into a database or a physical medium.

children.label: Data conversion and migration services
children.definition: Services of moving data from one storage device to another or from one file format to another.

children.label: Other information services
children.definition: This class comprises other information services.

children.label: Other information services
children.definition: This subclass comprises other information services.

children.label: Lending library services
children.definition: Providing access to library resources.

children.label: Archival institution services
children.definition: Providing access to archives, and other archive-related services.

children.label: Information services, n.e.c.
children.definition: Collecting, disseminating or providing access to information, n.e.c.

children.label: Financial services (except insurance)
children.definition: This group comprises financial system regulatory services; account and cash management products; loans and other credit financing products; investment products; financial planning services and trust products for individuals, businesses, institutions (except unincorporated) and governments; and products supporting financial services.

children.label: Financial system regulatory services
children.definition: This class comprises services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies (such as stock exchanges) to regulate financial systems and markets, and the participants in those systems and markets.

children.label: Regulation of securities markets
children.definition: This subclass comprises services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies (such as stock exchanges) to regulate securities markets and the participants in securities markets.

children.label: Regulation of securities markets
children.definition: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies (such as stock exchanges) to regulate securities markets and the participants in securities markets.

children.label: Regulation of credit markets
children.definition: This subclass comprises services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate credit markets and the participants in credit markets.

children.label: Regulation of credit markets
children.definition: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate credit markets and the participants in credit markets.

children.label: Regulation of insurance markets
children.definition: This subclass comprises services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate insurance markets and the participants in insurance markets.

children.label: Regulation of insurance markets
children.definition: Services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies to regulate insurance markets and the participants in insurance markets.

children.label: Account and cash management products
children.definition: This class comprises money management services, provided to customers by means of deposit accounts, such as chequing, savings and time accounts, and specialized cash management services that enable businesses to handle cash, transfer monies, and in general make and receive payments.

children.label: Deposit account service packages
children.definition: This subclass comprises bundled services related to deposit accounts (cheques, account statements, automated banking machine (ABM) transactions, etc.) provided for a flat fee, usually paid monthly. Non-deposit services, such as traveller's cheques, may be included in deposit account service packages.

children.label: Deposit account service packages
children.definition: Bundled services related to deposit accounts (cheques, account statements, automated banking machine (ATM) transactions, etc.) provided for a flat fee, usually paid monthly. Non-deposit services, such as traveller's cheques, may be included in deposit account service packages.

children.label: Separately-priced deposit account products
children.definition: This subclass comprises services related to deposit accounts, sold on an individual basis.

children.label: Separately-priced deposit account products
children.definition: Services related to deposit accounts, sold on an individual basis.

children.label: Cash handling and management products
children.definition: This subclass comprises specialized deposit account and cash management services provided to businesses and government.

children.label: Cash handling and management products
children.definition: Specialized deposit account and cash management services provided to businesses and government.

children.label: Payment document products
children.definition: This subclass comprises issuing documents that can be used as payment instruments.

children.label: Payment document products
children.definition: Issuing documents that can be used as payment instruments.

children.label: Foreign currency exchange at retail
children.definition: This subclass comprises exchanging the currency of one country for that of another in small amounts, for a fee or commission.

children.label: Foreign currency exchange at retail
children.definition: Exchanging the currency of one country for that of another in small amounts, for a fee or commission.

children.label: Loans
children.definition: This class comprises loans that represent the direct lending of funds under legal contract, either unsecured or secured by the assets being financed or by other assets, but without the exchange or the use of securities as collateral.

children.label: Loans to businesses
children.definition: This subclass comprises loans to businesses. Loans represent the direct lending of funds under legal contract, either unsecured or secured by the assets being financed or by other assets, but without the exchange or the use of securities as collateral.

children.label: Loans to businesses
children.definition: Loans to businesses. Loans represent the direct lending of funds under legal contract, either unsecured or secured by the assets being financed or by other assets, but without the exchange or the use of securities as collateral.

children.label: Loans to government
children.definition: This subclass comprises loans to government.

children.label: Loans to government
children.definition: Loans to government.

children.label: Loans to households
children.definition: This subclass comprises loans to households.

children.label: Residential mortgage loans
children.definition: Mortgage loans provided to owner-occupiers, secured by residential real property.

children.label: Home equity loans
children.definition: Loans and lines of credit secured by the equity of a borrower's residence.

children.label: Secured home loans (except residential mortgage and home equity loans) to households
children.definition: Secured or guaranteed home loans to households, except residential mortgage and home equity loans.

children.label: Vehicle loans to households
children.definition: Loans to households for purchasing automobiles and other vehicles, secured by the vehicle.

children.label: Other secured consumer loans to households, n.e.c.
children.definition: Other secured loans to households, n.e.c.

children.label: Unsecured loans to households
children.definition: Loans and lines of credit, not secured by collateral, for personal uses.

children.label: Credit financing (except loans)
children.definition: This class comprises credit card services; factoring; financial leasing; and sales financing.

children.label: Credit card products
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of lines of credit to credit card holders, and credit card processing services to merchants, that together enable credit cards to be accepted as a means of payment.

children.label: Credit card cardholder products for businesses and government
children.definition: Provision of a revolving line of credit to business and government holders of credit cards, allowing them to purchase goods and services from merchants who accept their card. Credit granted through credit cards may be unsecured, or secured by a deposit held by the card issuer.

children.label: Credit card cardholder products to consumers
children.definition: Provision of a revolving line of credit to consumer holders of credit cards, allowing them to purchase goods and services from merchants who accept their card. Credit granted through credit cards may be unsecured, or secured by a deposit held by the card issuer.

children.label: Credit card merchant products
children.definition: Credit card transaction processing services provided by processors and banks to merchant account holders.

children.label: Credit card association products
children.definition: Services provided by credit card associations to issuing banks.

children.label: Factoring
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of financing to a business from the sale of its accounts receivable to a third party, known as a factor. Normally, the factor assumes the full risk of collection, including credit losses.

children.label: Factoring
children.definition: Financing provided to a business from the sale of its accounts receivable to a third party, known as a factor. Normally, the factor assumes the full risk of collection, including credit losses.

children.label: Financial leasing
children.definition: This subclass comprises leases in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the machinery and equipment after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the equipment appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase. Also known as capital lease.

children.label: Financial leasing, motor vehicles
children.definition: Motor vehicle leases in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the motor vehicle after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the motor vehicle appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase.

children.label: Financial leasing (except motor vehicles)
children.definition: Leases (except for motor vehicles) in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the machinery and equipment after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the equipment appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase.

children.label: Sales financing
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of credit by means of conditional sales contracts.

children.label: Sales financing to businesses
children.definition: Providing credit by means of conditional sales contracts for purchases by businesses.

children.label: Sales financing to consumers
children.definition: Providing credit by means of conditional sales contracts for purchases by consumers.

children.label: Other credit financing products
children.definition: This class comprises financing services related to trading and dealing in securities which generally involve the use of securities as collateral or as the lent instrument, as well as other credit financing products, n.e.c.

children.label: Other credit financing products
children.definition: This subclass comprises financing services related to trading and dealing in securities which generally involve the use of securities as collateral or as the lent instrument, as well as other credit financing products, n.e.c.

children.label: Securities lending
children.definition: Collateralized lending of securities, to be returned on a specific date or on demand, paid for by fees based on the value of the loaned securities.

children.label: Repurchase agreements
children.definition: The sale of a security (often Treasury Bills) to a counterparty for cash with an agreement to repurchase it at a fixed price on a specified future date.

children.label: Other credit financing products, n.e.c.
children.definition: Provision of credit by means other than loans, credit cards, factoring, leasing, instalment credit products, and financing related to securities lending and repurchase agreements.

children.label: Investment products
children.definition: This class comprises securities origination products; brokering and dealing of financial instruments; and brokerage correspondent products.

children.label: Securities origination products
children.definition: This subclass comprises assisting the issuers of securities (businesses and government) in creating their securities and in having them distributed to the investing public. The service may involve advising the issuer; purchasing securities from the issuer and selling them (underwriting); or acting as an agent in marketing the securities.

children.label: Securities origination products
children.definition: Assisting the issuers of securities (businesses and government) in creating their securities and in having them distributed to the investing public. The service may involve advising the issuer; purchasing securities from the issuer and selling them (underwriting); or acting as an agent in marketing the securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of money market instruments
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing money market instruments, which are fixed-rate of return debt instruments that mature within one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, negotiable certificates of deposit
children.definition: Brokering and dealing negotiable certificates of deposit, with a term of one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, commercial paper issued by financial institutions
children.definition: Brokering and dealing commercial paper issued by financial institutions, with a term of one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, commercial paper issued by non-financial institutions
children.definition: Brokering and dealing commercial paper issued by non-financial institutions, with a term of one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, bankers' acceptances
children.definition: Brokering and dealing bankers' acceptances, with a term of one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, Treasury bills
children.definition: Brokering and dealing Treasury bills, with a term of one year or less.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, other money market instruments
children.definition: Brokering and dealing money market instruments other than commercial paper, bankers' acceptances, negotiable certificates of deposit, or Treasury bills.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of other debt instruments
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing debt instruments other than money market instruments.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, corporate bonds and asset-backed securities
children.definition: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term corporate notes and bonds, and asset-backed securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, national government notes and bonds
children.definition: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term bonds issued by the Government of Canada.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, provincial and local government notes and bonds
children.definition: Brokering and dealing medium- and long-term bonds issued by provincial and local governments.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, foreign government notes and bonds
children.definition: Brokering and dealing notes and bonds issued by foreign governments.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of equities
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing equity securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of equities
children.definition: Brokering and dealing equity securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of derivatives
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing in derivative instruments, which are contracts whose value is based on the value of an underlying entity.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, futures contracts, exchange-traded
children.definition: Brokering and dealing futures contracts on exchanges.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, option contracts, exchange-traded
children.definition: Brokering and dealing option contracts on exchanges.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, forward contracts, traded over-the-counter
children.definition: Brokering and dealing forward contracts over-the-counter.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, swaps, traded over-the-counter
children.definition: Brokering and dealing swap contracts over-the-counter.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, option contracts, traded over-the-counter
children.definition: Brokering and dealing option contracts over-the-counter.

children.label: Brokering and dealing products, other derivatives contracts, traded over-the-counter
children.definition: Brokering and dealing derivative contracts, other than forward, swap or option contracts, over-the-counter.

children.label: Foreign currency wholesale brokering and dealing
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing foreign currencies, on a wholesale basis.

children.label: Foreign currency wholesale brokering and dealing
children.definition: Brokering and dealing foreign currencies, on a wholesale basis.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of investment company securities
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing investment company securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of investment company securities
children.definition: Brokering and dealing investment company securities.

children.label: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments
children.definition: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing other financial instruments.

children.label: Brokerage or dealing services of cryptocurrency (virtual currency)
children.definition: Brokerage or dealing services of cryptocurrency (virtual currency).

children.label: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments
children.definition: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments.

children.label: Brokerage correspondent products
children.definition: This subclass comprises the service consisting of one broker-dealer carrying out trades on behalf of another, where the first broker-dealer has access to a particular securities exchange and the other does not.

children.label: Brokerage correspondent products
children.definition: Service consisting of one broker-dealer carrying out trades on behalf of another, where the first broker-dealer has access to a particular securities exchange and the other does not.

children.label: Personal trust and financial planning services
children.definition: This class comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services intended for private individuals.

children.label: Personal trust and financial planning services
children.definition: This subclass comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services intended for private individuals.

children.label: Personal trust services
children.definition: Services to establish and administer trusts, under which a trustee holds legal title to property belonging to another, for the benefit of a beneficiary. Trusts are defined by an agreement, contract, declaration in a will, or order of a court.

children.label: Personal financial planning and investment management services
children.definition: Financial planning and investment management services for individuals.

children.label: Trust and financial planning services for businesses, institutions, and government
children.definition: This class comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

children.label: Trust and financial planning services for businesses, institutions, and government
children.definition: This subclass comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

children.label: Trust services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments
children.definition: Services to establish and administer trusts for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

children.label: Financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments
children.definition: Financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

children.label: Tax planning and consulting services for businesses (except unincorporated) and governments
children.definition: Tax planning and consulting services for businesses (except unincorporated) and governments.

children.label: Products supporting financial services
children.definition: This class comprises management of financial market and clearing products; automated clearing house products; and other products supporting financial services.

children.label: Management of financial market and clearing services
children.definition: This subclass comprises the provision of an infrastructure for trading securities and commodity contracts; and clearing and settlement services for securities, commodities contracts, and payments. Covers trades executed on exchanges or over-the-counter, and clearing and settlement services for those trades.

children.label: Payment clearing and settlement services
children.definition: Clearing and settling payments for financial transactions other than trades of securities and commodity contracts.

children.label: Security and commodity contract trade execution, clearing and settlement services
children.definition: Executing, clearing and settling trades of securities and commodity contracts and other financial instruments.

children.label: Services of access to security and commodity contract trade execution and clearing systems
children.definition: Providing broker-dealers with access to securities or commodity contract trading systems, whether live floor exchanges or electronic systems.

children.label: Security and commodity contract exchange and clearing house listing services

children.label: Pension and annuity products

Plans may require a single contribution or a series of contributions; may be compulsory or optional; may have nominal benefits determined in advance or dependent on the market value of aspects supporting the plan; and, if related to employment, may or may not be portable with a change in employment. The duration of the period during which benefits are paid may be fixed in terms of a minimum or maximum; there may or may not be survivors' benefits.

The three parties are the principal (the party that undertakes the obligation), the surety (the party that guarantees that the obligation will be performed), and the obligee (the party that receives the benefit of the bond if the principal fails to meet the obligation).

Long-term employees are placed on the payroll of the staffing firm, which is legally responsible for their actions, but when working they are supervised by the client. This service also covers a staffing arrangement in which an organization (i.e., a professional employer organization (PEO)) co-employs a client's workforce. The PEO and the client enter into a contractual agreement whereby the rights and responsibilities in respect of co-employees are shared or allocated, with the service provider assuming responsibility for certain activities as agreed with the client. The services range from basic to full-service packages.

children.label: Business support services

children.label: Document processing services, and contract publishing services for others

children.label: Document preparation services
children.definition: Providing document editing (including technical editing), proofreading, layout, desktop publishing, and typing services.

children.label: Reprography services
children.definition: Providing copies from a paper original or an electronic copy.

children.label: Document finishing services
children.definition: Providing document finishing services, such as binding, mounting, folding, and wrapping, and making use of cut-outs and visual aids in the layout of documents and reports.

children.label: Contract publishing services for others
children.definition: Contract publishing of books, periodicals, journals, etc., for others (including self-publishing authors) who maintain copyright and editorial control. Technical services related to publishing such as editing, proofreading, content development, research and writing, and word processing are included. The services may be bundled or separate. Printing and distribution may be included if these activities are provided in combination with activities listed above.

children.label: Consulting services for book publishing
children.definition: Providing guidance and advice in relation to publishing books to other companies, entities, or persons. May include guidance and advice on a broad range of subjects such as publication planning, manuscript preparation and editing, documentation of historical fact or information, presentation and layout, and authorship and intellectual property rights.

children.label: Mailroom services, mailbox rentals, and mail-presorting services
children.definition: This subclass comprises providing mailbox rental services, mailroom services, such as mail assembly, sorting (including sorting mail by postal code), and delivery to post office, and other processing of mail prior to mailing, such as putting the sorted mail into mail trays.

children.label: Mailroom services, mailbox rentals, and mail-presorting services
children.definition: Providing mailbox rental services, mailroom services, such as mail assembly, sorting (including sorting mail by postal code), and delivery to post office, and other processing of mail prior to mailing, such as putting the sorted mail into mail trays.

children.label: Telemarketing and call support services
children.definition: This subclass comprises making or receiving telephone calls on behalf of others, for such purposes as marketing clients' goods or services, providing customer assistance, and providing answering services.

children.label: Telemarketing and call support services
children.definition: Making or receiving telephone calls on behalf of others, for such purposes as marketing clients' goods or services, providing customer assistance, and providing answering services.

children.label: Debt collection, and recovery services
children.definition: This subclass comprises initiating and securing the receipt of payment from delinquent debtors, and retrieving goods put up as collateral for a loan.

children.label: Debt collection, and recovery services
children.definition: Initiating and securing the receipt of payment from delinquent debtors, and retrieving goods put up as collateral for a loan.

children.definition: This class comprises investigation services to provide information about people, events or documents for use in legal proceedings, pre-employment verification, or domestic matters, or for other uses, as well as services to protect people and property provided by the private sector.

children.label: Investigation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises conducting investigations to provide information about people, events or documents for use in legal proceedings, pre-employment verification, or domestic matters, or for other uses, about such things as insurance claims and missing persons.

children.label: Investigation services
children.definition: Conducting investigations to provide information about people, events or documents for use in legal proceedings, pre-employment verification, or domestic matters, or for other uses, about such things as insurance claims and missing persons.

children.label: Security guard and patrol services
children.definition: This subclass comprises providing protection of people and property using guards and patrols. May include the use of dogs. Patrol officers provide protection to an establishment by patrolling in clearly marked vehicles or on foot, for the purpose of preventing and detecting criminal activity or safety problems such as fires.

children.label: Security guard and patrol services
children.definition: Providing protection of people and property using guards and patrols. May include the use of dogs. Patrol officers provide protection to an establishment by patrolling in clearly marked vehicles or on foot, for the purpose of preventing and detecting criminal activity or safety problems such as fires.

children.label: Bodyguard services

children.label: Bodyguard services
children.definition: Providing personal protection by deterring and preventing hazards to people's security, using specialized personnel (escorts and bodyguards).

children.label: Armoured car services

children.label: Armoured car services

children.label: Building security system monitoring services
children.definition: This subclass comprises monitoring of building alarm and security systems to detect intrusions and other problems. The response to an activated alarm may be notification of official agencies and/or a physical response by the monitoring service. Security systems may monitor for conditions such as fire and flooding, or the status of industrial equipment.

children.label: Residential building security system monitoring services
children.definition: Monitoring of residential building alarm and security systems to detect intrusions and other problems. The response to an activated alarm may be notification of official agencies and/or a physical response by the monitoring service. Security systems may monitor for conditions such as fire and flooding, or the status of industrial equipment.

children.label: Non-residential building security system monitoring services
children.definition: Monitoring of non-residential building alarm and security systems to detect intrusions and other problems. The response to an activated alarm may be notification of official agencies and/or a physical response by the monitoring service. Security systems may monitor for conditions such as fire and flooding, or the status of industrial equipment.

children.label: Building security system and lock installation and repair services

children.label: Non-residential building security system and lock installation and repair services

children.label: Cleaning services for buildings and dwellings
children.definition: This class comprises cleaning services for residential dwellings and non-residential buildings.

children.label: Residential cleaning services
children.definition: This subclass comprises cleaning services for residential dwellings. Covers interior cleaning; cleaning on-site and off-site residential carpet, rug and upholstery; and chimney and other specialized dwelling cleaning services.

children.label: Residential interior cleaning services
children.definition: Provision of general residential housekeeping services.

children.label: Residential on-site carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning residential carpets, rugs, furniture, and upholstery, at the customer's location, usually by the use of hot water, steam, or chemicals.

children.label: Residential off-site carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning residential carpets, rugs, furniture, and upholstery, off the customers' premises at a location owned or operated by the service provider, usually through the use of hot water, steam, or chemicals.

children.label: Chimney cleaning services
children.definition: Chimney cleaning services.

children.label: Other specialized residential cleaning services
children.definition: Specialized residential or home cleaning services, n.e.c.

children.label: Non-residential cleaning services
children.definition: This subclass comprises cleaning services for non-residential buildings. Covers general-purpose and comprehensive cleaning of rooms and other spaces; building exterior cleaning; on-site and off-site cleaning of non-residential carpets, rugs and upholstery; and disaster restoration and other specialized building cleaning services.

children.label: General-purpose and comprehensive non-residential cleaning services
children.definition: General-purpose and comprehensive cleaning services provided to non-residential properties, such as janitorial and custodial services, and hotel housekeeping services.

children.label: Non-residential on-site carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning non-residential carpets, rugs, furniture, and upholstery, at the customer's location, usually by the use of hot water, steam, or chemicals.

children.label: Non-residential off-site carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning non-residential carpets, rugs, furniture, and upholstery, off the customers' premises at a location owned or operated by the service provider, usually through the use of hot water, steam, or chemicals.

children.label: Non-residential exterior window cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning exterior panes of windows and glass doors on-site, for non-residential properties. May include incidental cleaning of window frames, sills, awnings and shutters.

children.label: Building exterior cleaning services
children.definition: Cleaning walls and other exterior surfaces of buildings using steam, water, chemicals or compressed air.

children.label: Disaster restoration and cleaning services
children.definition: On-site cleaning and restoration of damage caused to residential or non-residential buildings by fire, smoke, water, vandalism, and other natural or man-made disasters.

children.label: Hard-surface floor care services
children.definition: Specialized cleaning of hard-surface floors.

children.definition: Specialized non-residential cleaning services, n.e.c.

children.label: Pest extermination and control services
children.definition: This subclass comprises preventing, eliminating or controlling infestations of insects, rodents and other pests.

children.label: Residential pest extermination and control services
children.definition: Preventing, eliminating or controlling infestations of insects, rodents and other pests, in or around residential dwellings (houses, apartments, gardens, patios, and associated land).

children.label: Non-residential pest extermination and control services
children.definition: Preventing, eliminating or controlling infestations of insects, rodents and other pests, in or around non-residential buildings and structures (commercial, industrial and institutional buildings, and associated land).

children.label: Landscaping services and snow removal services for parking lots and driveways
children.definition: This subclass comprises caring for (including installation and removal) trees, shrubs, plants, lawns or gardens, and ploughing and removing snow from parking lots and driveways.

children.label: Residential landscaping services
children.definition: Caring for (including installation and removal) trees, shrubs, plants, lawns or gardens around residential properties.

children.label: Non-residential landscaping services
children.definition: Caring for (including installation and removal) trees, shrubs, plants, lawns or gardens, in or around parks and playgrounds, highways, roads, bridges, level crossings, and other non-residential properties.

children.label: Snow removal services for parking lots and driveways
children.definition: Snow ploughing and removal services for parking lots and driveways.

children.definition: This subclass comprises provision of a range of services to manage and service facilities which the client uses to carry out its own activity. The services provided are non-core with respect to the client's activity. The range of services provided depends on the nature of the facility, but generally includes administrative and building management services.

children.label: Facilities management support services
children.definition: Provision of a range of services to manage and service facilities which the client uses to carry out its own activity. The services provided are non-core with respect to the client's activity. The range of services provided depends on the nature of the facility, but generally includes administrative and building management services.

children.label: Packaging and labelling services
children.definition: Packaging and labelling goods owned by others. May include product assembly, package design, sterilization, or printing labels.

children.label: Fulfilment services
children.definition: Providing merchants with a combination of all or several services including storage of inventory, processing of orders (gathering and packing items ordered), shipping, billing, collecting payments for the order, and handling returns and exchanges.

children.label: Convention and trade show organization services

children.label: Waste management and remediation services
children.definition: This class comprises non-hazardous waste management services; hazardous waste management services; and remediation services.

children.label: Non-hazardous waste management services
children.definition: This subclass comprises non-hazardous waste and recyclable material collection services (residential and non-residential); non-hazardous construction and demolition waste collection services; destruction services for non-hazardous waste; non-hazardous waste and recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services; and non-hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services.

children.label: Residential non-hazardous waste and recyclable material collection services
children.definition: Collection and subcontracted collection of non-hazardous garbage, refuse, rubbish, trash, and recyclable materials (pre-sorted or not) from residential dwellings, including apartment buildings and condominiums. May be collected on a regular or flexible schedule and may be taken to a final disposal site or to an intermediate site such as a material recovery facility or transfer facility.

children.label: Non-residential non-hazardous waste and recyclable material collection services
children.definition: Collection and subcontracted collection of non-hazardous garbage, refuse, rubbish, trash, and recyclable materials (pre-sorted or not) from non-residential locations. May be collected on a regular or flexible schedule and may be taken to a final disposal site or to an intermediate site such as a material recovery facility or transfer facility.

children.label: Collection services for non-hazardous construction and demolition waste
children.definition: Collection and subcontracted collection of non-hazardous waste such as brush and debris from the construction, renovation, and demolition of buildings, bridges, roads and ports, and the clearing of land. Waste may be taken to an intermediate site or to a final disposal site.

children.label: Destruction services for non-hazardous waste
children.definition: Providing destruction services for confidential documents and other diverse non-hazardous products by means of special equipment. Includes collection services bundled with destruction services.

children.label: Non-hazardous waste and recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services
children.definition: Consolidating, storing, and preparing non-hazardous waste for transportation, and recovering recyclable materials from non-hazardous materials waste streams.

children.label: Non-hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services
children.definition: Disposal of non-hazardous waste by placing it in a landfill or sanitary landfill, or by incineration, or by other methods; operation, maintenance and monitoring of operational installations, maintenance and monitoring of closed installations, and closing of installations for non-hazardous waste disposal.

children.label: Non-hazardous waste management services, n.e.c.
children.definition: Providing non-hazardous waste management services, n.e.c.

children.label: Hazardous waste management services
children.definition: This subclass comprises hazardous waste collection services (residential and non-residential); hazardous waste and hazardous recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services; hazardous waste treatment services; and hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services.

children.label: Residential hazardous waste collection services
children.definition: Collection and subcontracted collection of hazardous waste from residential locations. Hazardous waste may include recyclable materials.

children.label: Non-residential hazardous waste collection services
children.definition: Collection and subcontracted collection of hazardous waste from non-residential locations. Hazardous waste may include recyclable materials.

children.label: Hazardous waste and hazardous recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services
children.definition: Consolidating, storing, and preparing hazardous waste for transportation, and recovering recyclable material from hazardous waste streams.

children.label: Hazardous waste treatment services
children.definition: Providing treatment services to reduce, eliminate, or transform hazardous waste. Processes include biological, chemical, and/or physical procedures, as well as incineration; such processes may lead to disposal and/or to the recovery of recyclable material.

children.label: Hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services
children.definition: Disposal of hazardous waste by controlled confinement by landfilling or above-ground containers and deep-well storage, or by incineration, or by other methods; operation, maintenance and monitoring of operational installations, maintenance and monitoring of closed installations, and closing of installations for hazardous waste disposal.

children.label: Hazardous waste management services, n.e.c.
children.definition: Providing services for the management of hazardous waste, n.e.c.

children.label: Remediation services
children.definition: This subclass comprises a wide variety of services provided for the remediation of sites whose air, water, and/or soil that has been contaminated by hazardous materials and substances.

children.label: Site remediation services
children.definition: Management of a contaminated site, for prevention, minimization, or mitigation of damage to human health or the environment. Remediation options may include direct physical actions, such as treatment, removal, or destruction of contaminants.

children.label: Building remediation services
children.definition: Development and implementation of a remediation plan that removes, destroys, contains or otherwise reduces contaminants in a building.

children.label: Adult basic education programs
children.definition: Programs and courses that focus on specific approved programs in basic education for adults, which may lead to high school completion.

children.label: Second language learning programs (non-credit)
children.definition: Programs and courses that focus on the development of proficiency in reading, writing and speaking a language other than the mother tongue.

children.label: Personal improvement programs
children.definition: Programs and courses that focus on other fundamental knowledge and skills that individuals need to function productively in society, whether in personal, social or career settings. Programs are typically not for academic credit.

children.label: Trade, career, technical and professional development training programs

children.label: Trade, career, technical and professional development training programs
children.definition: This subclass comprises programs and courses designed to train, upgrade or for professional development of individuals in the skilled trades or in entry level vocations, career and technical occupation. Programs are generally less than two years in length.

children.label: Trade, career and technical programs
